dedupe_keys.name: austria housing census gebaude und wohnungszahlung buildings and dwellings by political district time series from 2011 statistik austria ogd

description: Two open tables from Statistik Austria's register-based housing census (Gebäude- und Wohnungszählung) give the stock of buildings and of conventional dwellings in every Austrian political district for the census reference date of 31 October in 2011 and in each year from 2021 to 2024. Buildings are split by predominant use: residential buildings with one, two, or three or more dwellings, buildings for institutional households, and non-residential buildings. Dwellings are split by whether at least one person has their main residence there, which separates occupied from vacant or second homes. The producer is Statistik Austria, which derives the census from its Buildings and Dwellings Register and other administrative registers under the EU census regulation and the Austrian Register-based Census Act. Coverage is all of Austria at district level (117 units in the 2024 territorial structure). Format and access: semicolon-separated CSV with separate header and code-list files, plus a JSON service, downloadable without registration from data.statistik.gv.at. Licence: CC BY 4.0, free of charge. Caveats: counts only, no building-level records; the Vienna dwelling stock omits unoccupied dwellings created by extensions or conversions between 2012 and 2023, as the metadata notes; finer tables (municipality, construction period, heating) are in STATcube. Simulation uses: exposure models of the building stock, vacancy-aware demand estimates and district-level calibration of building stock models. Related records: the Swiss GWR register, the Danish BBR, Germany's Zensus 2022 grid and the EU Building Stock Observatory.
